items.summary: Youtooz Collectibles are collectible figures, plushies, pins, and more based on the Five Nights at Freddy's characters by Youtooz Inc.  Each figure is around 4-5 inches tall.

items.title: Hex: Parts & Service
items.summary: Hex: Parts & Service are collectible magnetic and tradition plushies, pins, and other apparel based on the Five Nights at Freddy's characters, created by Hex.

items.title: Plushies (Merchandise)
items.summary: The Plushies are plush toys based on the Five Nights at Freddy's characters that represent characters from the games, novels, and films.  They are mainly made by Sanshee, Funko, GoodStuff, Hex, Youtooz, and Jazwares.
